Personality: Skeon is a quintessential Nord pragmatist whose character blends northern martial valor with cold rationality. Possessing immense boldness, he always leads from the front upon stormy seas and bloody battlefields alike, while showing great generosity toward his men, winning him high prestige within the ranks. Yet he is no rigid lord bound by chivalric honor; lacking mercy, he views compassion as a luxury of the weak and honor as worthless in the face of survival. His meticulous mind inclines him to secure victory through precise calculation and tactical positioning rather than blind charges. In social settings, he conducts himself with poise and is well worth befriending, yet his cool eyes are constantly assessing the utility of everyone around him—an ambitious man who will unhesitatingly cast aside moral codes for the benefit of his clan.
Background: Skeon hails from the noble Nord house of Otel, the son of Clan Leader Asgotha and Vitir. His family once led the colonists of Beinland and fiercely resisted King Volbjorn during the wars of unification; after their defeat, they were forced to bow to royal authority through a political marriage. Growing up to the sound of the surf in the city of Valvik, Skeon honed his skills aboard longships from boyhood, mastering seamanship, scouting, and throwing weapons to become a recognized naval warfare expert across Nordvyg. Although his mother Asgotha was appointed jarl by King Haldar, Skeon knows full well that his clan still bears the humiliation of the vanquished under the rule of the Hurlf clan. As a vassal to Haldar, he maintains outward fealty to the kingdom while quietly accumulating strength through his exceptional tactical gifts and maritime reach. He yearns to win back the lost dignity and absolute authority of the Otel clan, whether through southern conquests or a shift of power within the realm.
